longDescription: & Others, commonly referred to as Salmagundi, was a 19th-century satirical periodical created and written by American writer Washington Irving, his oldest brother William, and James Kirke Paulding.

authorInfo.bio: William Irving · Washington Irving · James Kirke Paulding (1766–1821) wrote Salmagundi : or, The whimwhams and opinions of Launcelot Langstaff, esq., and others. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
